description: This is a FastAPI route module defining API endpoints for spatial terrain analysis related to 'sponge zones'. It includes functions for retrieving geojson feature collections of zones with pagination, filtering, caching, and detailed zone information, all per REST API best practices.

classes.name: SpongeZoneCollection
classes.description: Response model for a collection of sponge zones in GeoJSON format including metadata

classes.name: SpongeZoneFeature
classes.description: GeoJSON Feature structure representing a single sponge zone with geometry and properties

classes.description: Properties of a sponge zone used in GeoJSON features

classes.name: ZoneDetailResponse
classes.description: Response model for details of a specific zone

methods.description: Converts a database record into a GeoJSON Feature with geometry and properties

methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve a paginated, filtered, and cached collection of sponge zones as GeoJSON
